own_solution.law: Doppler effect in still air, twice (moving reflector as receiver then source), then a moving receiver: f_rec = f (c - u)/(c + u) * (c - w)/c with u = 6 m/s (lorry receding), w = 9 m/s (recorder moving with the reflected wave); answer = f - f_rec
assumptions: reflection with no frequency change in the panel's rest frame

notes: f_rec = 1500*337*334/(349*343) = 1500*112558/119707 = 1410.42 Hz; difference 89.58 Hz. With the recorder at 9+5.3 = 14.3 m/s relative to air: f_rec = 1500*337*328.7/119707 = 1388.04 Hz; difference 111.96 Hz. The 82 m distance belongs to the lorry but affects only arrival times, not the steady frequency; I label it C (or arguably K/D) with no change in answer. TDC03 and T6307 differ only in 'stands'/'is'. TA134 and TA6A4 carry no number (presumably controls).
